state_note: All three State JSON files and the prior workload_estimates.json were empty at phase start; no saved cuts or workload approvals applied.
scope_note: 38 source-map units plus three required preparation activities with no separate physical source: HR, aptitude and final mock. This is workload estimation only; no task inventory, resource research, feasibility or schedule is produced.
estimation_policy: Minutes are proposed focused preparation time, not note-reading-speed calculations, calendar blocks or guarantees of mastery. They exclude meals, breaks, classes and the assistant's planning/research time.

Placement notes and the user's own projects are treated as revision of previously encountered material. If substantial first-time learning is needed, affected estimates require review. EPQ prior core preparation is explicitly confirmed.
Each estimated_minutes value already includes all of its component minutes. Components are additive within a unit; do not add verification, questionnaires or mock feedback again elsewhere.
Core verification uses ChatGPT after subject revision/practice; each project questionnaire is a separate ChatGPT session after its revision. Resume questioning is also a later ChatGPT component.
DBMS and Node/backend include their reference theory; SQL and MongoDB add active query practice. Brief targeted refresh in practice is intentional retrieval, not a second full note-reading workload.

Supporting JSON, Collections, Extra Fundamentals, Redis, DSA references and companion images have no independent workload. Consult relevant material within the associated unit components; do not multiply shared-reference time across links. Redis remains an empty placeholder.

General DSA and all seven OA tasks have distinct time allocations. OA retains four Major and three Minor tasks; README is metadata only. Java applies to implementation/bug-fix work, while Task 7 is reasoning-only.

RecSys paired files are one unit each. Final revision adds consolidation after unit coverage. The separate numericals allowance is retained provisionally in totals until an explicit redundancy decision; no cut is implied.
External resources remain pending where flagged. Provisional figures are useful review baselines; missing evidence was not pursued solely to increase confidence.
inspection_note: Reused saved map sizes/roles. Counted words/lines only for 17 mapped larger/core/midsem Markdown files; obtained page counts for three PDFs; read seven small OA tasks directly. No new note headings, raw note content, images, PDF text or external sources inspected.
